facts.rationale: Replaces name-derived All-Star attribution with canonical implementation and observed Classic registration/dispatch.
facts.value: Owns mutable campaign storage used by Classic Mode and a separate stage-configuration table with eleven accessors; also implements a Classic campaign predicate and Classic-specific match-end accomplishment flag population.

evidence.why: Separate objects and exact read/write behavior.

facts.rationale: Separates table flow from campaign-buffer flow and preserves cross-file ownership and mutation boundaries.
facts.value: gm_GetAllStarData exposes static mutable byte storage, while eleven independent accessors read a separate 55-entry table using stage_slot + difficulty * 5 and return bytes or percentage-derived ratios. Classic initializes the shared record and installs these callbacks. The predicate reads mode and campaign state; match-end processing reads campaign/rule/reward/player inputs and sets packed flags in the supplied MatchEnd record without clearing the campaign or reward state.
